claims.evidence: Each name is one physical SILAC-labelled T3M4 cell population (one dish) in one of the two label-swapped mixtures. No pool or reference channel exists in this deposit, so no name is shared between runs.

claims.location: comment[label] rows 1-4 / characteristics[treatment] rows 1-4 / factor value[treatment] rows 1-4
claims.value: FL0025604: light=untreated, heavy=Puromycin; FL0025606: light=Puromycin, heavy=untreated
claims.evidence: Explicit map (paper Methods, Enrichment of newly synthesized proteins): "The forward condition combined whole-cell lysates extracted from light control cells and heavy puromycin/sgMETTL13-treated cells at a mass ratio of 1:1; the reverse condition combined lysates of heavy control cells and light cells with puromycin". Ext. Data Fig. 4b: "two SILAC experiments with label-swapped conditions". File assignment: MaxQuant summary.txt experiment names FL0025604=WT-L (wild-type/control in light = forward), FL0025606=WT-H (control in heavy = reverse). Data check (orientation.txt): non-normalized log2 H/L median -2.35 with 99.4% of 1400 protein groups <0 in WT-L (heavy = puromycin, translation inhibited) and +2.64 with 99.8% of 1250 >0 in WT-H (light = puromycin); paper: ">99% of these proteins had decreased abundance in puromycin-treated cells". Sources agree; no conflict.

Paper Methods: 3 h in SILAC-labelled deficient medium with 10% dialysed FBS, 100 nM AHA and 5 ug/ml puromycin for the treatment; controls without puromycin. NCIT:C787 Puromycin (not obsolete). Controls = untreated (batch rule 4). Dose/duration (5 ug/ml, 3 h) recorded here, not in a column.

Two label-swapped SILAC experiments (Ext. Data Fig. 4b); each experiment used separately SILAC-labelled and treated dishes, so within each factor group (untreated, Puromycin) there are two independent cultures, numbered 1 and 2 (README.adoc:330, batch rule 3).

claims.evidence: Custom characteristics column (spec Extending Templates), same name/value as sibling PXD062091. Paper Methods: 18 h serum starvation, 1 h methionine depletion, then 3 h in deficient medium with 10% dialysed FBS and 100 nM AHA; AHA-labelled nascent proteins covalently linked to alkyne agarose resin (Click-&-Go kit 1033). Applies to all four samples.

claims.value: 5 ug/mL, 3 hour (Puromycin rows 2,3); not applicable (untreated rows 1,4)
claims.evidence: Paper Methods: "3 h in the aforementioned SILAC-labelled deficient medium supplemented with 10% dialysed FBS, 100 nM AHA and 5 ug ml-1 puromycin for the treatment". Column names and value patterns from spec TERMS.tsv (dose NCIT:C25488, exposure duration NCIT:C83280; licensed there by clinical-metadata, used here as spec-defined custom columns without declaring that template, rule 15). not applicable for untreated controls (no compound).
Cellosaurus DI NCIt C9120 Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma -> MONDO:0005184 pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (not obsolete). All rows are the same cancer cell line; no healthy control arm.
Cultured T3M4 cells (Cellosaurus CA Cancer cell line).

Newly synthesized (AHA-labelled) proteins were captured on alkyne agarose resin by click chemistry (Click-&-Go kit 1033) and digested on-resin (paper Methods; PRIDE sample protocol). No EFO child of EFO:0009090 describes nascent-protein/AHA enrichment (descendant list checked in OLS), so the generic EFO:0009106 sample enrichment is used.
Cellosaurus CVCL_4056 "Population: Japanese" (genome ancestry ~99% East Asian, PubMed=30894373); HANCESTRO:0019 Japanese (not obsolete).
Cellosaurus AG 64Y; >= 20Y -> EFO:0001272 adult (batch rule 9).
Cellosaurus SX Male.

Paper: "T3M4 cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo, 88364) supplemented with 10% dialysed FBS"; NCIT:C185409 Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium. During the 4-h pulse cells were in Lys/Arg/Leu/Met-deficient DMEM (Molecular Dimensions MD12-420) + SILAC Lys/Arg, Leu and AHA.

Raw headers of both files: "Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Method Summary", creator Lumos-PC; paper: Fusion Lumos. PRIDE dropdown says Orbitrap Fusion (MS:1002416) - overridden by the raw files and the paper/PRIDE protocol text ("Fusion Lumos").
Paper: data-dependent mode, top speed, 3 s cycle; PRIDE experiment type DDA.

Arg10 = +10.008 Da = UNIMOD:267, Lys8 = +8.014 Da = UNIMOD:259; paper heavy amino acids [13C6,15N2]-L-lysine and [13C6,15N4]-L-arginine (Silantes). SILAC labels MT=Variable (batch rule 11).
parameters.txt "MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm" (Orbitrap MS2); paper "fragment mass tolerances ... 20 ppm".

Search output: in the deposited evidence.txt the largest |Mass Error [ppm]| over all 59,482 identified evidence rows is 4.500 ppm (ISO-MSMS n=39613 max 4.500; MULTI-MSMS n=17504 max 4.463; MULTI-SECPEP n=2365 max 4.360; 114 MS/MS rows in the 4.0-4.5 ppm bin, none above), i.e. the MaxQuant main-search default cutoff of 4.5 ppm that the paper's "default settings" implies. CONFLICT: paper and PRIDE text say "precursor and fragment mass tolerances were set to 7 and 20 ppm"; 7 ppm equals the "MS/MS deisotoping tolerance (FTMS) 7 ppm" in parameters.txt and is contradicted by the data, so the data-derived 4.5 ppm is used (same value as sibling PXD062091).

limitations: comment[precursor mass tolerance] = 4.5 ppm is inferred from the deposited evidence.txt mass-error distribution (hard cutoff at 4.500 ppm = MaxQuant main-search default) because parameters.txt (MaxQuant 1.5.5.1) does not record the peptide tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited. It conflicts with the authors' text ("7 and 20 ppm"), where 7 ppm matches the MS/MS deisotoping tolerance; the first-search tolerance (MaxQuant default 20 ppm) cannot be verified.

characteristics[enrichment process] uses the generic EFO:0009106 sample enrichment because no ontology term for AHA/click-chemistry capture of newly synthesized proteins exists under EFO:0009090; the specific procedure (100 nM AHA pulse 3 h, Click-&-Go alkyne agarose resin, on-resin digestion) is only in this manifest.

The 18 h serum starvation preceding the AHA pulse is recorded only in this manifest (the AHA pulse itself is in characteristics[nascent protein labeling]; puromycin dose/duration in characteristics[dose] / characteristics[exposure duration]).
characteristics[cell type], characteristics[passage number], characteristics[sample storage temperature] = not available: not stated in the paper or PRIDE record.
